text:
Priya (CS): Quick heads-up — Q2 customer enablement is getting busy. We need to rejigger office-hours coverage and workshop slots for timezone overlap. Thinking a rotating trainer pool (round-robin) + an on-call handoff doc. Thoughts?

Alex (CSM): +1. Which cohorts are highest priority? Renewal-risk accounts and new Dedicated migrations should get priority.

Morgan (Enablement): I can own the round-robin pattern. Proposal: 2-week blocks per trainer, paired handoff week for shadowing. Covers continuity and context handoff.

Priya (CS): Good. Also want a quick way for CSMs to flag "urgent enablement" (renewal signal) that bumps a slot. Maybe a channel tag and a single-line form.

Alex (CSM): For urgent flags: +1 to a short form (Google Sheet or simple Airtable). We need SLA — respond within 24h and commit an enablement slot within 72h for renewal-risk folks.

Morgan (Enablement): Drafted a small runbook snippet. Will post in #docs after we agree. Minimal required fields: account name, account health score, reason (renewal / migration / onboarding), preferred windows, critical blockers.

Priya (CS): Perfect. Can we automate triage with the enablement bot? cs-bot, any chance you can add a reaction that creates a draft calendar invite and ping the next trainer in pool?

cs-bot: I can create a draft invite and ping trainers if you add the :enable-tech: reaction. To configure pool rotation, post a comma-separated list to `@cs-bot set-pool` with trainer handles.

Alex (CSM): Sample rotation list: Morgan, Priya, Jordan, Mei. How strictly do we rotate for timezone coverage? e.g., APAC-friendly trainers every 3rd rotation?

Morgan (Enablement): Let's make rotation order flexible — have a secondary index for timezone blocks. My suggestion: primary round-robin for fairness, but trainers can swap in a calendar week block for timezone needs. I'll keep a public schedule and tag swaps with :swap:.

Jules (Customer): Thanks for the heads-up — from customer's side, morning APAC windows are best. We'll push a short preference poll to customers in the affected cohort.

Priya (CS): Okay next steps: 1) Morgan posts draft runbook + rotation commands by EOD tomorrow. 2) Alex captures SLA language and the short triage form. 3) I'll coordinate with Sales ops to add renewal flags to the sheet. 4) cs-bot set-pool Morgan,Priya,Jordan,Mei when ready.

Morgan (Enablement): On it. I'll include a tiny code snippet for the set command in the runbook:```
@cs-bot set-pool Morgan,Priya,Jordan,Mei
@cs-bot enable-reaction :enable-tech:
```

Alex (CSM): I'll draft the SLA lines and the sheet columns, pinging Matt in Sales Ops after this.

Priya (CS): Thanks — if anyone can't take their block, please post a swap request in this thread with preferred replacements. We'll surface any coverage gaps in the weekly ops sync. :raised_hands:
